comments.text: Not to be a Debbie Downer but over 85% of the video clips are reversed.  For one thing you do not drive on the left side of the road as shown in some of the clips.  For someone who has been to the island over 8 times it was confusing to watch this video.

comments.text: The landings are genuinely spectacular from the beach. The jet blast behind the fence is not part of the attraction, it's what killed someone there and injured plenty more. Watch the approach, skip the fence. Change my mind.

replies.text: I completely agree with you. Watching the low approach safely from the beach is by far the best and safest experience.
